functions.name: A Flow with one amount, in the period that contains a date.
functions.semantics: A Flow with one amount, in the period that contains a date. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow, with the amount on its date and zero elsewhere.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the amount.

functions.name: A Flow made by the distribution profile Uniform.
functions.semantics: A Flow made by the distribution profile Uniform. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.from_profile with rangekeeper.profile.Uniform.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the total, which is an amount, not an amount per unit of time.

functions.name: A Flow made by the growth profile Compounding.
functions.semantics: A Flow made by the growth profile Compounding. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.from_profile with rangekeeper.profile.Compounding.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the initial amount for each Period: an amount per unit of time, such as AUD pa, times the Period's length, in AUD.

functions.name: The amount of the period that contains a date.
functions.semantics: The amount of the period that contains a date. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.at.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The same periods, with zero after a date.
functions.semantics: The same periods, with zero after a date. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.until.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The net present value of a Flow on a date.
functions.semantics: The net present value of a Flow on a date. Mirrors rangekeeper.finance.npv.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The running totals of a Flow.
functions.semantics: The running totals of a Flow. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.cumulative.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The larger of two values, period by period for Flows.
functions.semantics: The larger of two values, period by period for Flows. Mirrors Python's built-in max, period by period.
functions.unit_rule: The arguments have compatible units; the result has the units of the larger argument.

functions.name: Each amount less the amount before it.
functions.semantics: Each amount less the amount before it. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.diff.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The interest on a balance in each period.
functions.semantics: The interest on a balance in each period. Mirrors rangekeeper.finance.interest.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the balance.

functions.name: The internal rate of return of a Flow: the rate whose NPV is zero.
functions.semantics: The internal rate of return of a Flow: the rate whose NPV is zero. Mirrors rangekeeper.finance.irr.
functions.unit_rule: The result is a rate per year, in % pa.

functions.name: The largest amount of a Flow.
functions.semantics: The largest amount of a Flow. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.max.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The same periods, with zero before a date.
functions.semantics: The same periods, with zero before a date. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.since.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.

functions.name: The sum of the amounts of a Flow.
functions.semantics: The sum of the amounts of a Flow. Mirrors rangekeeper.flow.Flow.total.
functions.unit_rule: The result has the units of the Flow.
